passages.text: In the first month, the whole congregation of Israel entered the Wilderness of Zin and stayed in Kadesh. There Miriam died and was buried.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were a large group of people.
They were called the congregation of Israel.
They entered the Wilderness of Zin.
This happened in the first month.
They stayed in a place called Kadesh.
Miriam was with them.
Miriam died in Kadesh.
They buried Miriam there.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ בְנֵֽי־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל כָּל־ הָ֨עֵדָ֤ה מִדְבַּר־ צִן֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽרִאשׁ֔וֹן וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב הָעָ֖ם בְּקָדֵ֑שׁ וַתָּ֤מָת שָׁם֙ מִרְיָ֔ם וַתִּקָּבֵ֖ר שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: Now there was no water for the congregation, so they gathered against Moses and Aaron.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were a large group of people.
They traveled together in the wilderness.
They reached a place called Kadesh.
There was no water for the people to drink.
The people gathered together.
They came to Moses and Aaron.
They opposed Moses and Aaron because there was no water.
passages.original: וְלֹא־ הָ֥יָה מַ֖יִם לָעֵדָ֑ה וַיִּקָּ֣הֲל֔וּ עַל־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְעַֽל־ אַהֲרֹֽן׃

passages.text: The people quarreled with Moses and said, “If only we had perished with our brothers before the LORD!
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel argued with Moses.
They spoke to Moses.
They said, “We wish we had died with our brothers.
Our brothers died before the LORD.”
passages.original: וַיָּ֥רֶב הָעָ֖ם עִם־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לֵאמֹ֔ר וְל֥וּ גָוַ֛עְנוּ בִּגְוַ֥ע אַחֵ֖ינוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Why have you brought the LORD’s assembly into this wilderness for us and our livestock to die here?
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel spoke to Moses and Aaron.
They said, “You brought the LORD’s assembly into this wilderness.
Why did you bring us here?
We will die here.
Our livestock will die here.”
passages.original: וְלָמָ֤ה הֲבֵאתֶם֙ אֶת־ קְהַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר הַזֶּ֑ה לָמ֣וּת שָׁ֔ם אֲנַ֖חְנוּ וּבְעִירֵֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Why have you led us up out of Egypt to bring us to this wretched place? It is not a place of grain, figs, vines, or pomegranates—and there is no water to drink!”
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel spoke to Moses.
They said, “You led us out of Egypt.
Why did you bring us to this terrible place?
This place is not good.
There is no grain here.
There are no fig trees here.
There are no grapevines here.
There are no pomegranates here.
There is no water to drink here.”
passages.original: וְלָמָ֤ה הֶֽעֱלִיתֻ֙נוּ֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם לְהָבִ֣יא אֹתָ֔נוּ אֶל־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הָרָ֖ע הַזֶּ֑ה לֹ֣א׀ מְק֣וֹם זֶ֗רַע וּתְאֵנָ֤ה וְגֶ֙פֶן֙ וְרִמּ֔וֹן וּמַ֥יִם אַ֖יִן לִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Then Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. They fell facedown, and the glory of the LORD appeared to them.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Aaron was his brother and helper.
The people of Israel gathered together.
Moses and Aaron left the people.
They went to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
Moses and Aaron fell facedown on the ground.
The glory of the LORD appeared to Moses and Aaron.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹא֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְאַהֲרֹ֜ן מִפְּנֵ֣י הַקָּהָ֗ל אֶל־ פֶּ֙תַח֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיֵּרָ֥א כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Take the staff and assemble the congregation. You and your brother Aaron are to speak to the rock while they watch, and it will pour out its water. You will bring out water from the rock and provide drink for the congregation and their livestock.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses instructions.
The LORD told Moses to take the staff.
The LORD told Moses to gather the congregation.
Moses and his brother Aaron were to gather the people.
The LORD told Moses and Aaron to speak to the rock.
The people would watch them speak to the rock.
The rock would give its water.
Moses would bring water out from the rock.
Moses would give water to the congregation.
Moses would give water to their livestock.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ קַ֣ח אֶת־ הַמַּטֶּ֗ה וְהַקְהֵ֤ל אֶת־ הָעֵדָה֙ אַתָּה֙ וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִ֔יךָ וְדִבַּרְתֶּ֧ם אֶל־ הַסֶּ֛לַע לְעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם וְנָתַ֣ן מֵימָ֑יו וְהוֹצֵאתָ֨ לָהֶ֥ם מַ֙יִם֙ מִן־ הַסֶּ֔לַע וְהִשְׁקִיתָ֥ אֶת־ הָעֵדָ֖ה וְאֶת־ בְּעִירָֽם׃

passages.text: So Moses took the staff from the LORD’s presence, just as he had been commanded.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
The LORD had given Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to take the staff.
The staff was in the LORD’s presence.
Moses took the staff from before the LORD.
Moses obeyed the LORD’s command.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ הַמַּטֶּ֖ה מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: Then Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly in front of the rock, and Moses said to them, “Listen now, you rebels, must we bring you water out of this rock?”
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Aaron was Moses’ brother and helper.
Moses and Aaron gathered all the people of Israel.
They brought the people to stand in front of a rock.
Moses spoke to the people.
He said, “Listen now, you rebels.”
He asked, “Must we bring you water out of this rock?”
passages.original: וַיַּקְהִ֜לוּ מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְאַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת־ הַקָּהָ֖ל אֶל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַסָּ֑לַע וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֗ם שִׁמְעוּ־ נָא֙ הַמֹּרִ֔ים הֲמִן־ הַסֶּ֣לַע הַזֶּ֔ה נוֹצִ֥יא לָכֶ֖ם מָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Then Moses raised his hand and struck the rock twice with his staff, so that a great amount of water gushed out, and the congregation and their livestock were able to drink.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
He stood before the people and the rock.
Moses lifted his hand.
He held his staff in his hand.
Moses struck the rock with his staff.
He struck the rock two times.
A great amount of water came out from the rock.
The people drank the water.
Their livestock also drank the water.
passages.original: וַיָּ֨רֶם מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־ יָד֗וֹ וַיַּ֧ךְ אֶת־ הַסֶּ֛לַע בְּמַטֵּ֖הוּ פַּעֲמָ֑יִם וַיֵּצְאוּ֙ מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים וַתֵּ֥שְׁתְּ הָעֵדָ֖ה וּבְעִירָֽם׃ס

passages.text: But the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you did not trust Me to show My holiness in the sight of the Israelites, you will not bring this assembly into the land that I have given them.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron.
He said, “You did not trust Me.
You did not show My holiness to the Israelites.
You did this in front of all the people.
Because of this, you will not lead this assembly.
You will not bring them into the land I have given them.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֒ יַ֚עַן לֹא־ הֶאֱמַנְתֶּ֣ם בִּ֔י לְהַ֨קְדִּישֵׁ֔נִי לְעֵינֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לָכֵ֗ן לֹ֤א תָבִ֙יאוּ֙ אֶת־ הַקָּהָ֣ל הַזֶּ֔ה אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥תִּי לָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: These were the waters of Meribah, where the Israelites quarreled with the LORD, and He showed His holiness among them.
passages.sermon: The Israelites quarreled with the LORD at the waters of Meribah.\r\nGod showed His holiness among the Israelites at that place.
passages.original: הֵ֚מָּה מֵ֣י מְרִיבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ רָב֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּקָּדֵ֖שׁ בָּֽם׃ס

passages.text: From Kadesh, Moses sent messengers to tell the king of Edom, “This is what your brother Israel says: You know all the hardship that has befallen us, how our fathers went down to Egypt, where we lived many years. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers, and when we cried out to the LORD, He heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Now look, we are in Kadesh, a city on the edge of your territory.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses sent messengers from Kadesh.
Moses sent them to the king of Edom.
Moses spoke for the people of Israel.
Israel called Edom “brother.”
Moses said, “You know what happened to us.”
Moses said, “Our ancestors went down to Egypt.”
The Israelites lived in Egypt for many years.
The Egyptians treated the Israelites badly.
The Egyptians also treated the ancestors of Israel badly.
The Israelites cried out to the LORD.
The LORD heard the Israelites’ voice.
The LORD sent an angel.
The LORD brought the Israelites out of Egypt.
Now the Israelites were in Kadesh.
Kadesh was a city on the edge of Edom’s territory.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֧ה מַלְאָכִ֛ים מִקָּדֵ֖שׁ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֱד֑וֹם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אָחִ֣יךָ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתָּ אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַתְּלָאָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר מְצָאָֽתְנוּ׃ וַיֵּרְד֤וּ אֲבֹתֵ֙ינוּ֙ מִצְרַ֔יְמָה וַנֵּ֥שֶׁב בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וַיָּרֵ֥עוּ לָ֛נוּ מִצְרַ֖יִם וְלַאֲבֹתֵֽינוּ׃ וַנִּצְעַ֤ק אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע קֹלֵ֔נוּ וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח מַלְאָ֔ךְ וַיֹּצִאֵ֖נוּ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וְהִנֵּה֙ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ בְקָדֵ֔שׁ עִ֖יר קְצֵ֥ה גְבוּלֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Please let us pass through your land. We will not cut through any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will stay on the King’s Highway; we will not turn to the right or to the left until we have passed through your territory.”
passages.sermon:
The Israelites spoke to the king of Edom.
They asked for permission to pass through his land.
They said, “Please let us pass through your land.
We will not go through any field.
We will not go through any vineyard.
We will not drink water from any well.
We will walk only on the King’s Highway.
We will not turn to the right.
We will not turn to the left.
We will do this until we have passed through your territory.”
passages.original: נַעְבְּרָה־ נָּ֣א בְאַרְצֶ֗ךָ לֹ֤א נַעֲבֹר֙ בְּשָׂדֶ֣ה וּבְכֶ֔רֶם וְלֹ֥א נִשְׁתֶּ֖ה מֵ֣י בְאֵ֑ר דֶּ֧רֶךְ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ נֵלֵ֗ךְ לֹ֤א נִטֶּה֙ יָמִ֣ין וּשְׂמֹ֔אול עַ֥ד אֲשֶֽׁר־ נַעֲבֹ֖ר גְּבוּלֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: But Edom answered, “You may not travel through our land, or we will come out and confront you with the sword.”
passages.sermon: Edom spoke to Moses and the Israelites.\r\nEdom said, “You may not pass through our land.\r\nIf you try to pass, we will come out against you with the sword.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ אֱד֔וֹם לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר בִּ֑י פֶּן־ בַּחֶ֖רֶב אֵצֵ֥א לִקְרָאתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: “We will stay on the main road,” the Israelites replied, “and if we or our herds drink your water, we will pay for it. There will be no problem; only let us pass through on foot.”
passages.sermon:
The Israelites spoke to Edom.
The Israelites said, "We will walk on the main road."
The Israelites said, "If we or our animals drink your water, we will pay for it."
The Israelites said, "We will not cause any trouble."
The Israelites said, "Let us pass through your land on foot."
passages.original: וַיֹּאמְר֨וּ אֵלָ֥יו בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל בַּֽמְסִלָּ֣ה נַעֲלֶה֒ וְאִם־ מֵימֶ֤יךָ נִשְׁתֶּה֙ אֲנִ֣י וּמִקְנַ֔י וְנָתַתִּ֖י מִכְרָ֑ם רַ֥ק אֵין־ דָּבָ֖ר בְּרַגְלַ֥י אֶֽעֱבֹֽרָה׃

passages.text: But Edom insisted, “You may not pass through.” And they came out to confront the Israelites with a large army and a strong hand.
passages.sermon:
Edom spoke to the Israelites.
Edom said, “You may not pass through.”
Edom gathered a large army.
Edom came out to confront the Israelites.
Edom showed great strength.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֣א תַעֲבֹ֑ר וַיֵּצֵ֤א אֱדוֹם֙ לִקְרָאת֔וֹ בְּעַ֥ם כָּבֵ֖ד וּבְיָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה׃

passages.text: So Edom refused to allow Israel to pass through their territory, and Israel turned away from them.
passages.sermon:
Edom was a nation.
Edom refused to let Israel pass through their land.
Israel was a people traveling together.
Israel turned away from Edom.
passages.original: וַיְמָאֵ֣ן׀ אֱד֗וֹם נְתֹן֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עֲבֹ֖ר בִּגְבֻל֑וֹ וַיֵּ֥ט יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵעָלָֽיו׃פ

passages.text: After they had set out from Kadesh, the whole congregation of Israel came to Mount Hor.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were a large group of people.
They left the place called Kadesh.
All the Israelites traveled together.
They came to a mountain called Mount Hor.
passages.original: וַיִּסְע֖וּ מִקָּדֵ֑שׁ וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֖ה הֹ֥ר הָהָֽר׃

passages.text: And at Mount Hor, near the border of the land of Edom, the LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Aaron will be gathered to his people; he will not enter the land that I have given the Israelites, because both of you rebelled against My command at the waters of Meribah.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron at Mount Hor.
Mount Hor was near the border of the land of Edom.
The LORD said these words to Moses and Aaron.
The LORD said, “Aaron will be gathered to his people.
Aaron will not enter the land I have given to the Israelites.
I gave this land to the Israelites.
Aaron cannot enter because you both rebelled against My command.
You rebelled against My command at the waters of Meribah.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן בְּהֹ֣ר הָהָ֑ר עַל־ גְּב֥וּל אֶֽרֶץ־ אֱד֖וֹם לֵאמֹֽר׃ יֵאָסֵ֤ף אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל־ עַמָּ֔יו כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָבֹא֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ מְרִיתֶ֥ם אֶת־ פִּ֖י לְמֵ֥י מְרִיבָֽה׃

passages.text: Take Aaron and his son Eleazar and bring them up Mount Hor.
passages.sermon:
Moses stood with the people of Israel at Mount Hor.
God spoke to Moses.
God told Moses to take Aaron.
God told Moses to take Eleazar, Aaron’s son.
God told Moses to bring Aaron and Eleazar up Mount Hor.
passages.original: קַ֚ח אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְאֶת־ אֶלְעָזָ֖ר בְּנ֑וֹ וְהַ֥עַל אֹתָ֖ם הֹ֥ר הָהָֽר׃

passages.text: Remove Aaron’s priestly garments and put them on his son Eleazar. Aaron will be gathered to his people and will die there.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses and Aaron at Mount Hor, near the border of Edom.
God gave Moses a command.
God said, “Take off Aaron’s priestly garments.
Put these garments on Eleazar, Aaron’s son.
Aaron will be gathered to his people.
Aaron will die there.”
passages.original: וְהַפְשֵׁ֤ט אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֔יו וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֖ם אֶת־ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר בְּנ֑וֹ וְאַהֲרֹ֥ן יֵאָסֵ֖ף וּמֵ֥ת שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: So Moses did as the LORD had commanded, and they climbed Mount Hor in the sight of the whole congregation.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
Moses obeyed the LORD.
Moses took Aaron and Eleazar.
They climbed Mount Hor together.
All the people of Israel watched them go up the mountain.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה וַֽיַּעֲלוּ֙ אֶל־ הֹ֣ר הָהָ֔ר לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃

passages.text: After Moses had removed Aaron’s garments and put them on his son Eleazar, Aaron died there on top of the mountain. Then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Aaron was the high priest and Moses’ brother.
Eleazar was Aaron’s son.
Moses took the priestly garments off Aaron.
Moses put the priestly garments on Eleazar.
Aaron died there on top of the mountain.
Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
passages.original: וַיַּפְשֵׁט֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֗יו וַיַּלְבֵּ֤שׁ אֹתָם֙ אֶת־ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר בְּנ֔וֹ וַיָּ֧מָת אַהֲרֹ֛ן שָׁ֖ם בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֑ר וַיֵּ֧רֶד מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר מִן־ הָהָֽר׃

passages.text: When the whole congregation saw that Aaron had died, the entire house of Israel mourned for him thirty days.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
The whole congregation saw that Aaron had died.
All the people of Israel understood that Aaron was gone.
The entire house of Israel mourned for Aaron.
They mourned for thirty days.
passages.original: וַיִּרְאוּ֙ כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה כִּ֥י גָוַ֖ע אַהֲרֹ֑ן וַיִּבְכּ֤וּ אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹן֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים י֔וֹם כֹּ֖ל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
